offences.quote: Submitting AI generated work as your own is academic misconduct.
You must not AI if you have been told not to do so in the assessment brief.
offences.anchor: When is it not appropriate to use AI?

detection.quote: You may be asked to discuss your work to demonstrate your understanding.

process.quote: If it is not completed, or not completed accurately, lecturers may need to contact you about your submission.
